objective_pt: Falar de situações imaginárias e de arrependimentos com o segundo e o terceiro condicional e com "I wish".

teacher.goal_pt: Aquecer com perguntas imaginárias e ver se o aluno já usa "would".
prompts: What would you do if you won the lottery?
If you could live anywhere, where would you live?
watchFor: Dizer "If I would win..."; o "would" fica só na outra parte da frase.
Dizer "If I win the lottery, I will..." para algo muito improvável; o segundo condicional soa mais natural.

exercises.prompt: If I had more free time, I'd learn to play the guitar.
accepted: If I had more free time, I'd learn to play the guitar.
If I had more free time, I would learn to play the guitar.
If I had more free time, I'd learn to play guitar.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na parte do "if" usamos o passado simples: "If I had". O "would" vai só no resultado.
commonErrors.correction_en: If I had more free time, I'd learn to play the guitar.

exercises.instruction_pt: Which sentence talks about an imaginary situation now?
options: If I lived by the sea, I'd go surfing every day.
If I live by the sea, I go surfing every day.
If I will live by the sea, I'll go surfing every day.
exercises.explanation_pt: O segundo condicional (if + passado, would + verbo) fala de algo imaginário no presente: a pessoa não mora na praia.

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Se eu fosse rico, eu viajaria o mundo todo."
accepted: If I were rich, I'd travel all over the world
If I were rich, I would travel all over the world
If I was rich, I'd travel all over the world
If I was rich, I would travel all over the world
If I were rich, I'd travel around the world
If I were rich, I would travel around the world
If I was rich, I'd travel around the world
If I were rich, I'd travel the whole world
If I were rich, I'd travel the world
I'd travel all over the world if I were rich
I would travel around the world if I were rich

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "if" não vai "would": "If I were rich" (ou "If I was rich", mais informal).
commonErrors.correction_en: If I were rich, I'd travel all over the world.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Viajar o mundo" é "travel the world" ou "travel around the world", sem "for".
commonErrors.correction_en: If I were rich, I'd travel around the world.

teacher.goal_pt: Aprender estruturas para imaginar e lamentar: I wish, if only, supposing, would have, regret.
prompts: Is there anything you wish you could change about your city?
Do you regret any decision you made?
watchFor: Dizer "I wish I have" em vez de "I wish I had".

exercises.meaning_pt: eu queria que, quem me dera
exercises.example_en: I wish I spoke Spanish as well.
I regret not taking that job in London.
Supposing you lost your job tomorrow, what would you do?

exercises.instruction_pt: Match each expression to its meaning.
Say it in English: "Eu queria ter mais tempo para a minha família."
accepted: I wish I had more time for my family
I wish I had more time to spend with my family
I wish I could spend more time with my family
I wish I had more time with my family
I wish I'd have more time for my family
If only I had more time for my family

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "I wish" para o presente, o verbo vai para o passado: "I wish I had".
commonErrors.correction_en: I wish I had more time for my family.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Eu queria ter" no sentido de desejo impossível é "I wish I had". "I wanted to have" soa como um desejo do passado.
commonErrors.correction_en: I wish I had more time for my family.

teacher.goal_pt: Treinar as formas reduzidas: "I'd", "would've" ("wúdav") e "wouldn't have".
prompts: Say "I would have gone" fast. What happens to "have"?
Say "I'd" and "I". Can you hear the difference?
watchFor: Pronunciar "would have" separado e devagar; na fala fica "would've".
Engolir o "d" de "I'd" até virar só "I".

exercises.instruction_pt: Repeat. Say "would've" as one short word.
exercises.prompt: If I'd known, I would've called you.
accepted: If I'd known, I would've called you.
If I had known, I would have called you.
If I'd known, I would have called you.
If I had known, I'd have called you.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Na fala, "would've" parece "would of", mas a forma escrita e gramatical é "would have".
commonErrors.correction_en: If I'd known, I would have called you.

exercises.instruction_pt: Repeat. Keep the "d" in "I'd" light but clear.
exercises.prompt: I'd rather stay home tonight, to be honest.
accepted: I'd rather stay home tonight, to be honest.
I would rather stay home tonight, to be honest.

exercises.instruction_pt: In "I'd go home", what is "I'd" short for?
exercises.explanation_pt: Antes de um verbo na forma base ("go"), "I'd" é "I would". Antes de particípio ("I'd gone"), é "I had".

teacher.goal_pt: Entender frases condicionais rápidas e responder a perguntas imaginárias.
prompts: What would you do in my shoes?
What would you have done differently?
watchFor: Responder "I will..." a uma pergunta com "would".
Dizer "If I were you, I will...".

exercises.listen: If we'd left ten minutes earlier, we wouldn't have missed the flight.
exercises.explanation_pt: O terceiro condicional fala do passado que não aconteceu: eles não saíram mais cedo e perderam o voo.

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen and give advice with "If I were you".
exercises.listen: My boss keeps giving me extra work and I'm exhausted. What should I do?
accepted: If I were you, I'd talk to my boss
If I were you, I would talk to my boss
If I were you, I'd talk to your boss
If I were you, I'd talk to him
If I were you, I'd talk to her
If I were you, I'd say no
If I were you, I'd speak to my boss
If I were you, I'd have a talk with my boss
If I was you, I'd talk to my boss
If I were you, I'd tell my boss
If I were you, I'd tell my boss I'm exhausted
If I were you, I'd look for another job
If I were you, I'd ask for help

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com "If I were you" o resultado usa "would" ("I'd"), não "will".
commonErrors.correction_en: If I were you, I'd talk to my boss.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para dar conselho imaginando-se no lugar da pessoa, use o passado: "If I were you".
commonErrors.correction_en: If I were you, I'd talk to my boss.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "No seu lugar" é "If I were you" ou "in your shoes". "In your place" é tradução literal.
commonErrors.correction_en: If I were you, I'd talk to my boss.

exercises.instruction_pt: Listen and answer: did she take the job?
exercises.listen: I wish I'd accepted that job offer in Canada.
accepted: No, she didn't
No
No, she didn't take it
No, she didn't accept it
No, she didn't accept the job
No, she didn't accept the offer
No, she regrets not taking it
No, and she regrets it
She didn't take the job

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "I wish I'd accepted" (eu queria ter aceitado) indica arrependimento: ela não aceitou o emprego.
A resposta curta no passado usa "didn't": "No, she didn't".

teacher.goal_pt: Conversar sobre escolhas imaginárias e arrependimentos com o segundo e o terceiro condicional.
prompts: If you could change one thing in your life, what would it be?
What would you have studied if you hadn't chosen your career?
What would happen if nobody had a phone?
watchFor: Misturar os condicionais: "If I had studied, I would get..." (pode ser misto de propósito, mas checar a intenção).

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Se eu tivesse estudado mais, teria passado na prova."
accepted: If I had studied more, I would have passed the exam
If I'd studied more, I would've passed the exam
If I'd studied more, I'd have passed the exam
If I had studied more, I would have passed the test
If I'd studied more, I would have passed the test
If I had studied harder, I would have passed the exam
If I'd studied harder, I would've passed the test
I would have passed the exam if I had studied more

commonErrors.explanation_pt: No terceiro condicional, a parte do "if" usa "had + particípio": "If I had studied". O "would have" vai no resultado.
commonErrors.correction_en: If I had studied more, I would have passed the exam.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: "Passar na prova" é "pass the exam", sem preposição.
commonErrors.correction_en: If I had studied more, I would have passed the exam.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Falta o "have": "would have passed" (na fala, "would've passed").
commonErrors.correction_en: I would have passed the exam.

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "O que você faria se perdesse o emprego amanhã?"
accepted: What would you do if you lost your job tomorrow?
If you lost your job tomorrow, what would you do?
What would you do if you were fired tomorrow?
What would you do if you got fired tomorrow?
Supposing you lost your job tomorrow, what would you do?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Com "would" na pergunta, a parte do "if" vai para o passado: "if you lost".
commonErrors.correction_en: What would you do if you lost your job tomorrow?

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Em inglês usamos o possessivo com coisas da pessoa: "lost your job". E "employment" não é o emprego de alguém.
commonErrors.correction_en: What would you do if you lost your job tomorrow?

accepted: What would you have done in my shoes

exercises.instruction_pt: Answer the hypothetical question. Talk about the present and the past.
exercises.prompt_en: If you could go back ten years, what advice would you give yourself, and what would you have done differently?
guidelines_pt: Use the second conditional: "If I could..., I would..."
Use the third conditional for a regret: "If I had..., I would have..."
Add a wish: "I wish I had..."

teacher.goal_pt: Revisar os condicionais e o "I wish".
prompts: What do you wish you had done last year?
If you were the president, what would you change?

exercises.instruction_pt: Say it in English: "Se eu fosse você, eu aceitaria a oferta."
accepted: If I were you, I'd accept the offer
If I were you, I would accept the offer
If I was you, I'd accept the offer
If I was you, I would accept the offer
If I were you, I'd take the offer
If I were you, I would take the offer
I'd accept the offer if I were you
I'd take the offer if I were you

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Para se imaginar no lugar de alguém, use o passado: "If I were you".
commonErrors.correction_en: If I were you, I'd accept the offer.

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Situação imaginária pede "would": "I'd accept", não "I will accept".
commonErrors.correction_en: If I were you, I'd accept the offer.

exercises.instruction_pt: Complete with the right form of "know".
exercises.sentence: If I had ___ about the party, I would have come.
accepted: known

commonErrors.explanation_pt: Depois de "had" usamos o particípio: "had known".
commonErrors.correction_en: If I had known about the party, I would have come.

options: I wish I could speak Japanese.
I wish I can speak Japanese.
I wish I will speak Japanese.
exercises.explanation_pt: Depois de "I wish" sobre o presente, o verbo vai uma casa para trás: "can" vira "could".

exercises.prompt: If only I'd listened to your advice!
accepted: If only I'd listened to your advice!
If only I had listened to your advice!
